Notes: Car1 makes two trips from Kakani. The first collects 2 elderly at Suryagadhi and 2 elderly at Panchakanya, which costs 126 minutes of driving for 200 minutes of penalty avoided. The second collects the 4 children at Syaphru for 70 minutes. Car2 makes two round trips from Kalika to Belkot (32 minutes each) to collect all 5 children. The remaining 3 adults at Syaphru and the 1 elderly person at Thakre are deferred, since the driving needed to reach them costs more than their penalties. Driving totals 260 minutes and penalties total 110.
